title: Structural Coherence Evaluation for Physical Theories: A Theory-Agnostic Framework with Observation-Native Ontology and Self-Imposed Falsifiability
description: Presents a theory-agnostic evaluation framework to assess structural coherence and falsifiability of physical theories without privileging any paradigm. It operationalizes four principles (observation-native ontology, declared structural vulnerability, priced adaptation, primitive transparency) via five structural metrics and a graph-based implementation, including self-imposed falsifiability through forbidden observational patterns.

explanatory_compression.description: Explanatory Compression: number of distinct tested phenomena explained per independent primitive assumption (Principle IV: Primitive Transparency).

forbidden_pattern_coverage.description: Effective coverage of declared forbidden observational patterns, weighted by Ontological Reliance Level (Principle II: Declared Structural Vulnerability).

key_results.main_finding: Introduces and demonstrates a cross-paradigm, observation-native framework that operationalizes self-imposed falsifiability and structural coherence metrics, with illustrative case studies across ΛCDM, EFC, and MOND.
datasets_used: Methodology paper; demonstration via case studies (ΛCDM, Entropy-Gradient EFC, MOND/Modified Gravity) rather than direct datasets.

sealed_predictions.statement: Framework rankings and metric scores remain stable under reasonable variations of counting choices and ontology-independent data encodings.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Show that small, reasonable changes to observation-native counting or encoding materially reorder theory rankings (Robustness Failure; TCS-F1).

sealed_predictions.statement: Framework coherence profiles correlate with domain-expert comparative judgments across diverse benchmark sets.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Demonstrate systematic anti-correlation between framework outputs and independent expert panels across multiple controlled benchmarks (Epistemic Divergence; TCS-F2).

sealed_predictions.statement: Scoring incentivizes deeper, theory-internal forbidden patterns over vacuous or trivial declarations.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Construct a toy theory that maximizes scores via trivial or vacuous forbidden patterns while a mature theory with deeper constraints is penalized (Performative Falsifiability; TCS-F3).

kill_criteria: KC1: Robustness Failure (TCS-F1): Material reordering of theory rankings under reasonable variations of observation-native counting or encoding.
KC2: Epistemic Divergence (TCS-F2): Systematic anti-correlation between framework coherence assessments and independent expert judgments across benchmark comparisons.
KC3: Performative Falsifiability (TCS-F3): Scoring function rewards trivial or vacuous forbidden-pattern declarations over deeper theory-internal constraints, enabling gaming by toy models.
abstract: A theory-agnostic evaluation framework for assessing structural coherence and falsifiability of physical theories. Introduces four operational principles and five structural metrics for cross-paradigm comparison without privileging any specific ontology.

I.name: Observation-Native Ontology
I.description: Phenomena defined as measured observables, not theory-laden constructs

II.name: Declared Structural Vulnerability
II.description: Theories must specify forbidden observational patterns from internal constraints

III.name: Priced Adaptation
III.description: Survival through modification carries explicit epistemic cost

framework_forbidden_patterns.TCS-F1: Robustness Failure - rankings change under reasonable counting variations
framework_forbidden_patterns.TCS-F2: Epistemic Divergence - systematic opposition to expert assessment
framework_forbidden_patterns.TCS-F3: Performative Falsifiability - rewards trivial over deep forbidden patterns

case_studies.name: ΛCDM
case_studies.profile: High coverage, moderate anomaly burden, limited self-declared falsifiability

case_studies.name: Entropy-Gradient (EFC)
case_studies.profile: High declared falsifiability, limited coverage, low plasticity

case_studies.name: MOND/Modified Gravity
case_studies.profile: High galactic compression, declining consistency in extensions

key_innovations: Self-imposed falsifiability as operational, machine-checkable property
Forbidden patterns derived from constitutive laws

relationship_to_existing.Bayesian_evidence: Complementary - operates at theory level, not model level
relationship_to_existing.Pre-registration: Extends from experiments to theoretical frameworks
